001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.economy;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.QSCancellable;
005import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.inventory.InventoryWrapper;
006import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
007import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
008import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component;
009import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
010import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
011
012import java.math.BigDecimal;
013import java.util.UUID;
014
015/**
016 * Calling when purchaser purchased a shop
017 */
018public class ShopPurchaseEvent extends AbstractQSEvent implements QSCancellable {
019
020  private final ShopTransactionContext context;
021
022  private boolean cancelled;
023  private @Nullable Component cancelReason;
024
025  /**
026   * Builds a new shop purchase event Will called when purchase starting For recording purchase,
027   * please listen to ShopSuccessPurchaseEvent.
028   *
029   * @param shop               The shop bought from
030   * @param purchaser          The player buying, may offline if purchase by plugin
031   * @param purchaserInventory The purchaseing target inventory, *MAY NOT A PLAYER INVENTORY IF
032   *                           PLUGIN PURCHASE THIS*
033   * @param amount             The amount they're buying
034   * @param total              The total balance in this purchase
035   */
036  public ShopPurchaseEvent(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final QUser purchaser, @NotNull final InventoryWrapper purchaserInventory, final int amount, final double total) {
037
038    this(new ShopTransactionContext(
039            shop,
040            purchaser,
041            purchaserInventory,
042            ShopTransactionDirection.fromShopType(shop.getShopType()),
043            amount,
044            BigDecimal.valueOf(shop.getPrice()),
045            BigDecimal.valueOf(total)));
046  }
047
048  /**
049   * Builds a pre-transaction event around a shared lifecycle context.
050   *
051   * @param context the context that will also be used by the success or failure event
052   */
053  public ShopPurchaseEvent(@NotNull final ShopTransactionContext context) {
054
055    this.context = context;
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Gets the item stack amounts
060   *
061   * @return Item stack amounts
062   */
063  public int getAmount() {
064
065    return context.getItemAmount();
066  }
067
068  /**
069   * Gets the number of configured shop units requested in this transaction. A shop unit may contain
070   * more than one individual item.
071   *
072   * @return the requested shop unit count
073   */
074  public int getTradeCount() {
075
076    return context.getTradeCount();
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  public @Nullable Component getCancelReason() {
081
082    return this.cancelReason;
083  }
084
085  @Override
086  public void setCancelled(final boolean cancel, @Nullable final Component reason) {
087
088    this.cancelled = cancel;
089    this.cancelReason = reason;
090  }
091
092  /**
093   * Gets the purchaser, that maybe is a online/offline/virtual player.
094   *
095   * @return The purchaser uuid
096   */
097  public @NotNull QUser getPurchaser() {
098
099    return context.getTrader();
100  }
101
102  /**
103   * Gets the inventory of purchaser (the item will put to)
104   *
105   * @return The inventory
106   */
107  public @NotNull InventoryWrapper getPurchaserInventory() {
108
109    return context.getTraderInventory();
110  }
111
112  /**
113   * Gets the shop
114   *
115   * @return the shop
116   */
117  public @NotNull Shop getShop() {
118
119    return context.getShop();
120  }
121
122  /**
123   * Gets the total money trans for
124   *
125   * @return Total money
126   */
127  public double getTotal() {
128
129    return context.getTotalPrice().doubleValue();
130  }
131
132  /**
133   * Gets the effective total price before tax without converting it to a double.
134   *
135   * @return the effective total price
136   */
137  public @NotNull BigDecimal getTotalPrice() {
138
139    return context.getTotalPrice();
140  }
141
142  /**
143   * Sets new total money trans for
144   *
145   * @param total Total money
146   */
147  public void setTotal(final double total) {
148
149    setTotalPrice(BigDecimal.valueOf(total));
150  }
151
152  /**
153   * Sets the effective total price before tax.
154   *
155   * @param total the new effective total price
156   */
157  public void setTotalPrice(@NotNull final BigDecimal total) {
158
159    context.setTotalPrice(total);
160  }
161
162  /**
163   * Gets the shared lifecycle context.
164   *
165   * @return the transaction context
166   */
167  public @NotNull ShopTransactionContext getContext() {
168
169    return context;
170  }
171
172  /**
173   * Gets the id shared by all lifecycle events for this transaction attempt.
174   *
175   * @return the transaction id
176   */
177  public @NotNull UUID getTransactionId() {
178
179    return context.getTransactionId();
180  }
181
182  @Override
183  public boolean isCancelled() {
184
185    return this.cancelled;
186  }
187}
